notes_for_editor: Thin record: one 1942 survey description (reproduced on the Central US Lookouts page) and one state index listing. Sources give no build year, height, status, access or staffing, so none is stated. The NGS datasheet DL1288 was not read directly. The index listing is the only source for the Cleveland County and Forestry Commission attribution beyond the survey. Do not confuse with the Lee County community of Moro, which turned up in search results only. Record point 33.8202, -92.2783 was not checked against the survey's Kingsland tie.
